title: Valorant Spike Plant
blurb: Planting the Spike changes the shape of a Valorant round entirely. The clock flips, the pressure moves to the other team, and the beeping that will define everyone's next forty seconds begins. Riot designed the plant confirmation to cut cleanly through gunfire and comms chatter, so you never miss it no matter what else is happening on screen. Attackers hear reassurance in it; defenders hear a deadline. Excellent as a general-purpose sound for announcing that something has just become irreversible.
origin: The Spike plant confirmation from Valorant (Riot Games).
